site.title: LinkedIn
site.short_description: B2B profiles and Company Pages — website fields and link posts
site.long_description: LinkedIn profiles and Pages can link to your site. Confirm rel on the public profile or Page URL. Open linkedin.com.

opportunities.title: Personal profile link
opportunities.description: On your personal LinkedIn member profile, add your site in the Contact info / website field. See add website to your profile. Good for founders who want buyers to find you and your project on one profile.

steps.body: Go to your LinkedIn profile → Edit public profile → Contact info.
steps.title: Open your profile

steps.body: Enter your homepage URL, save, and confirm on your public member profile.
steps.title: Add your website

opportunities.title: Company Page website
opportunities.description: Create a LinkedIn Company Page for your brand. You must confirm you are authorized to act for the company. LinkedIn may require workplace verification with a work email on your company domain. See troubleshoot creating a Page. and add a website to your Page.

steps.body: Sign in with a personal LinkedIn account that has more than one connection (new accounts may need to wait one day). Follow Create a LinkedIn Page. Check the box that you are authorized to act for the organization. If LinkedIn blocks you, complete workplace verification with a work email at your company domain (e.g. you@yourcompany.com) per LinkedIn Help. If a Page already exists, request admin access instead of creating a duplicate.
steps.title: Create or claim a Company Page

steps.body: Page admin → Edit Page → enter Website URL and save—see LinkedIn Help.
steps.title: Add your website

opportunities.title: Page or profile link post
opportunities.description: Share an update with your URL. Publish on LinkedIn or schedule in OpenQuok once your LinkedIn channel is connected.

steps.body: Write a short post with context and one link preview.
steps.title: Compose the update

steps.body: Post now or schedule in OpenQuok for LinkedIn and your other channels.
steps.title: Publish or schedule

opportunities.title: Publish article
opportunities.description: Publish a long-form LinkedIn article from your member profile or as a Page content admin. Desktop only. Use the editor’s Link tool to add your product or docs URL in the body. Optional SEO title and description help discovery. Articles appear on your profile Activity and in followers’ feeds.

steps.body: On LinkedIn desktop, click Write article on the homepage. Outline a useful piece for your audience, add headings, and insert your site with the Link tool. See publish articles on LinkedIn and publish as your Page if you post as a Company Page.
steps.title: Draft the article on desktop

steps.body: Choose Publish as (yourself or your Page), set SEO settings if helpful, then click Publish. Share the article URL on other channels/groups.
steps.title: Publish and share

opportunities.title: Comment with link
opportunities.description: Comment on a relevant LinkedIn post with helpful context and your URL. Alternatively, OpenQuok Auto plug post can add a promotional comment with your link after your like threshold. Set up plugs after you connect LinkedIn.

steps.body: Find a post where you can add real value, write a short comment, and include your URL once when it belongs in the conversation. See comment on LinkedIn posts.
steps.title: Comment with a helpful link

steps.body: After you schedule or publish a post in OpenQuok, attach plug (likes threshold + comment with your link). Optional: linkedin-add-comment posts a comment from another connected LinkedIn channel on your post. This automation only works on your post not other's post.
steps.title: Comment on (your) Page posts
